name: codefast
description: LLM-free code intelligence for coding agents: definitions, references, callers, call paths and bug-report localisation from a fast structural index, in one call and few tokens.

interface.longDescription: codefast answers structural questions about a repository from a prebuilt index: where a symbol is defined, who calls or uses it (including through callback tables), what a function calls, how execution gets from one function to another, which function prints a message, and which files to open for a bug report or stack trace. It runs locally, calls no language model, and indexes very large repositories in seconds. The plugin adds a skill that runs the codefast command and an MCP server with five read-only tools.
defaultPrompt: Use codefast to find who calls this function.
Use codefast to show how execution gets from main to this function.
Use codefast to find where to look for this bug report.
